note: Canonical product ids. Every waitlist signup, funnel link and demand report keys on `id`. Offer design (gift, founding, milestones) is defined in DEMAND-CAPTURE-OFFERS.md; a milestone with no publishedAt was never a commitment, and one past atCount with no honouredAt is a P0 for steward-revenue.
